# zerops_project_export (Data Source)

Exports project YAML for inspection and migration. Exported YAML may contain secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zerops_project_export" "example" {
  project_id = "PROJECT_ID"
  reveal     = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project to export.

### Optional

- `reveal` (Boolean) Reveal secrets; requires a sudo token. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `yaml` (String, Sensitive) Exported YAML.
